name: Little Little Election
source:
School calls out for president election with 300 million yen as first prize.
There are three main candidates, so protagonist decides to help one of them get to the top.
Fierce election campaign begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
学校宣布举行学生会长选举，第一名可获得3亿日元奖金。
主要候选人共有三位，主人公决定帮助其中一人登上顶点。
激烈的竞选活动就此拉开帷幕。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
